title: Poorly Thought-Out Over-Door Lighted Mirror
text:
Poorly Thought-Out Over-Door Lighted Mirror. A few negatives, where to begin.

The mirror must be plugged in at all times to utilize the light bulbs feature. Most closet doors, assuming you want to use this to hang over your closet door, do not have electrical outlets close by. But even if you did have an electrical outlet close by, the provided cord is way too short.

The cord, besides being too short, has a round tip on one end and USB-A on the other. They do not include a USB power plug adapter.

They put the electrical port on the left side of the mirror 4 inches up from the bottom edge instead of at the bottom underside. So, you have a cord awkwardly sticking out the side higher up, instead of coming out on the bottom. This also is annoying because the cord is too short. You will need to buy a USB Extension Cable or use a regular power extension cord to use this mirror.

The lights flicker at lower brightness setting. This could be a defect, of course.
